instruction: Find Transformers toys suitable for children and arrange them by price from highest to lowest.

metadata.explanation: Task requires searching for Transformers toys on Kohls.com, filtering for kids category, and sorting by price from high to low. Evaluator verifies breadcrumbs contain 'Transformers', 'Toys', 'Kids' and sort selector shows 'Price High-Low' (S=5 in URL). Uses existing Chrome evaluator framework.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts breadcrumb navigation elements and sort selector from active Chrome tab HTML
Evaluator performs case-insensitive matching for breadcrumb items ('Transformers', 'Toys', 'Kids') and sort selector ('Price High-Low'), then stores results as lowercase keys
Metric correctly compares extracted lowercase keys with expected lowercase keys using exact matching
Expected values are semantically correct: breadcrumbs should contain product category hierarchy (Transformers > Toys > Kids) and sort should be 'Price High-Low'
URL parameter checking (url_include_expected_multichoice) provides additional validation that filters/sort are reflected in URL (S=5 for price high-low)
Complete coverage: verifies all requirements in instruction (product search + category filter + price sort)
The 'is_other_exist' check ensures no unexpected breadcrumb items are present, preventing false positives from incorrect navigation paths
